categories.main_business_segments: China Railway Prefabricated Construction Co., Ltd (CRPC) primarily operates in two main segments: prefabricated building intelligent manufacturing products and prefabricated smart construction services. The company offers a full industry chain ecosystem integrating R&D, manufacturing, construction, and digital operation and maintenance. It holds multiple construction qualifications including general contracting, steel structure, decoration, municipal public works, and electromechanical installation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced intelligent manufacturing with international production equipment and proprietary R&D in prefabricated components such as steel structures, PC components, composite wall panels, and integrated housing. It employs modular design and industrialized production methods, including BIM technology for smart construction and digital management. R&D focuses on green building materials, energy efficiency, low-carbon construction, and innovative assembly technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include real estate developers, construction companies, government agencies, and municipal clients. The company serves markets in residential, commercial, industrial, public infrastructure, and emergency housing sectors. It also targets large-scale projects such as railway stations and urban development zones, with increasing involvement in overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: CRPC operates primarily in China with major market presence in East China, Southwest China, North China, South China, and other regions. It has production bases in Beijing, Jiangsu, and Xinjiang, and has begun expanding into overseas markets with its first overseas steel structure project. The company continues to deepen regional market penetration and expand its footprint in key urban and rural development areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction supply chain. It manufactures prefabricated building components and provides integrated EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contracting services, including design, production, construction, and operation. It acts as both a supplier of building materials and a general contractor for prefabricated construction projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing brand influence, expanding EPC contracting, advancing green and low-carbon building technologies, and promoting intelligent construction. R&D efforts focus on new materials, modular assembly systems, steel structure innovations, energy-efficient building systems, and digital construction management. The company emphasizes technology integration, safety, quality improvement, and sustainable development aligned with national 'dual carbon' goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of prefabricated building products and provision of smart construction services under EPC contracts. The company earns income from material sales, service fees, project contracting, and related construction management. It also receives government subsidies related to green building initiatives and innovation support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CRPC is a leading domestic player in China's prefabricated building sector, recognized as the only high-tech innovation platform under China Railway Construction. It holds a strong market position with advanced manufacturing capabilities and comprehensive service offerings. Competitors include other large construction and prefabrication firms, but CRPC differentiates itself through integrated solutions, technology leadership, and strategic backing from China Railway Construction.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.9 billion, a 27.07% increase year-over-year, though it reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 64 million, a 60.85% reduction in loss compared to the prior year. Total assets reached RMB 4.03 billion, up 23.09%. The company is in a growth and optimization phase, improving operational efficiency and expanding market share despite industry risks.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CRPC offers integrated prefabricated building solutions combining intelligent manufacturing, smart construction, and digital operation, emphasizing high efficiency, energy saving, and environmental sustainability. Its products feature customization, advanced materials, and modular designs that reduce construction time and costs. The company’s comprehensive EPC services and strong R&D capabilities provide clients with reliable, high-quality, and innovative building solutions aligned with green development policies.
